title: THIS CHRISTMAS, I AM THE GIFT
passages: There was fire. There was cold water. There was a Christmas experiment in choosing my own presence. I wrapped myself as a reminder that I brought something to the world simply by being here.

I knew the pleasure of caring for other people, meeting needs, making everyone else smile. This time I wanted to enjoy the imagination I had been carrying around inside me. The silly parts. The vibrant parts. The sexy parts. I wanted some of that generosity to reach me, too.

reflections.prompt: What do you bring simply by showing up?
